analysis.title: Webtoon Strip Analysis & Optimization
analysis.webpLimitNote: The 16,383 px limit applies exclusively to WebP. In JPG or Original there is no restriction.
analysis.recommendationTitle: Cut Strip or Downscale Pixels? Quality Recommendation:
analysis.cutStripsDesc: Preserves 100% native resolution and sharpness (width stays intact without pixelating text). Cleanly splits between panels into successive pages of ~{height} px.
analysis.downscaleDesc: Reduces overall scale. In very long strips (> 22,000 px) it shrinks pixels by 35-50%, which may make lettering and fine details blurry.
analysis.jpgOriginalNote: 💡 Exporting to JPG or Original? In that case you don't need to cut or downscale anything: they support images up to 65,535 px without restrictions.
analysis.cutAllOversizedTitle: Cuts all critical strips between panels preserving 100% original resolution and quality
analysis.downscaleAllTitle: Reduces resolution to 16,383 px for WebP
analysis.confirmDownscaleAll:
Are you sure you want to reduce resolution of {count} pages to 16,383 px?

Note: If these are long webtoon strips, downscaling can make dialogs slightly blurry. To keep 100% original sharpness, cancel and use "Cut all strips".
analysis.downscaleSuccessSingle: Page resized successfully to WebP-compatible size (≤ 16,383 px).
analysis.downscaleSuccessAll: All critical images have been resized to 16,383 px!
analysis.downscaleError: Error resizing page. Make sure the backend server is running.
